user_prompt: We need to establish a comprehensive procurement and delivery workflow that coordinates vendor assessment, augments customer purchases with enriched data, validates regulatory requirements, and manages incoming stock alongside staff and resource allocation. The process should also track milestone progression and delivery status throughout the entire cycle, including the ability to handle customer grievances and reconcile any disagreements that arise during fulfillment. Can you design this end-to-end supply chain orchestration to ensure seamless coordination across all these interconnected operations?

The activity "Handle customer grievances" requires a capability to receive, log, track, and resolve customer complaints or issues. None of the candidates are equipped for this core grievance management function:

- The campaign/marketing APIs (CampaignAccessManagementAPI, JourneyContactStateAPI, CampaignContactEngagementAPI, SegmentDrivenCampaignOptimizer) focus on campaign orchestration and engagement, not complaint handling
- The compliance/safety APIs (SafetyComplianceCustomerAPI) manage compliance validation, not grievance resolution
- The data products provide analytics on campaign performance, service metrics, or vendor segmentation—not grievance management capabilities
- None have capabilities for ticketing, complaint logging, issue tracking, resolution workflows, or escalation management

While these resources address customer interaction broadly, they lack the specific grievance/complaint handling functionality the activity requires.
